purpose.to_describe: the metadata and form of a NetCDF-format file

abbrev_widget_len.description: an arbitrary example of a data variable

xxxxx_Group_Attributes.group: can omit/empty, xxxxx is group name

summary.value: This file is the preprocessed form of a single raw PREFIRE Level-0 bus telemetry data file, is a required input for Level-1A processing, and will not be archived at a DAAC.

UTC_datetime_repr.description: UTC datetime of bus telemetry entry, represented as an integer
UTC_datetime_repr.value_meaning: YYYYMMDDhhmmssxxx, UTC date and time of bus telemetry entry, xxx=milliseconds)

ctime.description: at each bus telemetry entry; similar to TAI, and referenced to the epoch 2000-01-01T00:00:00 UTC

REFS_is_valid.description: is there a valid REFS group for this bus telemetry entry?

REFS_ESM_is_valid.description: is there a valid REFS_ESM (Earth-Sun-Moon) subgroup for this bus telemetry entry?

ATT_DET_is_valid.description: is there a valid ATT_DET group for this bus telemetry entry?

beta_angle.description: the angle between the orbital plane of the Earth-orbiting spacecraft and the geocentric position of the sun

SC_in_Earth_penumbra.description: is the spacecraft currently in the Earth penumbra?

SC_in_Earth_umbra.description: is the spacecraft currently in the Earth umbra?

SC_in_moon_penumbra.description: is the spacecraft currently in the moon penumbra?

SC_in_moon_umbra.description: is the spacecraft currently in the moon umbra?

position_wrt_ECI_1.long_name: position component 1 with respect to ECI frame
position_wrt_ECI_1.description: orbit position component 1 (x), reported in the ECI (J2000) frame

position_wrt_ECI_2.long_name: position component 2 with respect to ECI frame
position_wrt_ECI_2.description: orbit position component 2 (y), reported in the ECI (J2000) frame

position_wrt_ECI_3.long_name: position component 3 with respect to ECI frame
position_wrt_ECI_3.description: orbit position component 3 (z), reported in the ECI (J2000) frame

q_scbody_wrt_ECI_1.long_name: quaternion component 1 with respect to ECI frame
q_scbody_wrt_ECI_1.description: attitude quaternion component 1, spacecraft body frame with respect to ECI (J2000) frame

q_scbody_wrt_ECI_2.long_name: quaternion component 2 with respect to ECI frame
q_scbody_wrt_ECI_2.description: attitude quaternion component 2, spacecraft body frame with respect to ECI (J2000) frame

q_scbody_wrt_ECI_3.long_name: quaternion component 3 with respect to ECI frame
q_scbody_wrt_ECI_3.description: attitude quaternion component 3, spacecraft body frame with respect to ECI (J2000) frame

q_scbody_wrt_ECI_4.long_name: quaternion component 4 with respect to ECI frame
q_scbody_wrt_ECI_4.description: attitude quaternion component 4 (scalar, always positive), spacecraft body frame with respect to ECI (J2000) frame

velocity_wrt_ECI_1.long_name: velocity component 1 with respect to ECI frame
velocity_wrt_ECI_1.description: orbit velocity component 1 (u), reported in the ECI (J2000) frame

velocity_wrt_ECI_2.long_name: velocity component 2 with respect to ECI frame
velocity_wrt_ECI_2.description: orbit velocity component 2 (v), reported in the ECI (J2000) frame

velocity_wrt_ECI_3.long_name: velocity component 3 with respect to ECI frame
velocity_wrt_ECI_3.description: orbit velocity component 3 (w), reported in the ECI (J2000) frame

mod_SC_sun_vec_wrt_SBF_1.long_name: modeled spacecraft to sun vector component 1 with respect to spacecraft body frame
mod_SC_sun_vec_wrt_SBF_1.description: modeled spacecraft to sun vector, component 1 (x), reported in the spacecraft body frame

mod_SC_sun_vec_wrt_SBF_2.long_name: modeled spacecraft to sun vector component 2 with respect to spacecraft body frame
mod_SC_sun_vec_wrt_SBF_2.description: modeled spacecraft to sun vector, component 2 (y), reported in the spacecraft body frame

mod_SC_sun_vec_wrt_SBF_3.long_name: modeled spacecraft to sun vector component 3 with respect to spacecraft body frame
mod_SC_sun_vec_wrt_SBF_3.description: modeled spacecraft to sun vector, component 3 (z), reported in the spacecraft body frame

mod_SC_sun_vec_wrt_ECI_1.long_name: modeled spacecraft to sun vector component 1 with respect to ECI frame
mod_SC_sun_vec_wrt_ECI_1.description: modeled spacecraft to sun vector, component 1 (x), reported in the ECI (J2000) frame

mod_SC_sun_vec_wrt_ECI_2.long_name: modeled spacecraft to sun vector component 2 with respect to ECI frame
mod_SC_sun_vec_wrt_ECI_2.description: modeled spacecraft to sun vector, component 2 (y), reported in the ECI (J2000) frame

mod_SC_sun_vec_wrt_ECI_3.long_name: modeled spacecraft to sun vector component 3 with respect to ECI frame
mod_SC_sun_vec_wrt_ECI_3.description: modeled spacecraft to sun vector, component 3 (z), reported in the ECI (J2000) frame

mod_SC_moon_vec_wrt_SBF_1.long_name: modeled spacecraft to moon vector component 1 with respect to spacecraft body frame
mod_SC_moon_vec_wrt_SBF_1.description: modeled spacecraft to moon vector, component 1 (x), reported in the spacecraft body frame

mod_SC_moon_vec_wrt_SBF_2.long_name: modeled spacecraft to moon vector component 2 with respect to spacecraft body frame
mod_SC_moon_vec_wrt_SBF_2.description: modeled spacecraft to moon vector, component 2 (y), reported in the spacecraft body frame

mod_SC_moon_vec_wrt_SBF_3.long_name: modeled spacecraft to moon vector component 3 with respect to spacecraft body frame
mod_SC_moon_vec_wrt_SBF_3.description: modeled spacecraft to moon vector, component 3 (z), reported in the spacecraft body frame

mod_SC_moon_vec_wrt_ECI_1.long_name: modeled spacecraft to moon vector component 1 with respect to ECI frame
mod_SC_moon_vec_wrt_ECI_1.description: modeled spacecraft to moon vector, component 1 (x), reported in the ECI (J2000) frame

mod_SC_moon_vec_wrt_ECI_2.long_name: modeled spacecraft to moon vector component 2 with respect to ECI frame
mod_SC_moon_vec_wrt_ECI_2.description: modeled spacecraft to moon vector, component 2 (y), reported in the ECI (J2000) frame

mod_SC_moon_vec_wrt_ECI_3.long_name: modeled spacecraft to moon vector component 3 with respect to ECI frame
mod_SC_moon_vec_wrt_ECI_3.description: modeled spacecraft to moon vector, component 3 (z), reported in the ECI (J2000) frame

nadir_vec_wrt_SBF_1.long_name: nadir vector component 1 with respect to spacecraft body frame
nadir_vec_wrt_SBF_1.description: nadir vector (spacecraft to Earth), component 1 (x), reported in the spacecraft body frame

nadir_vec_wrt_SBF_2.long_name: nadir vector component 2 with respect to spacecraft body frame
nadir_vec_wrt_SBF_2.description: nadir vector (spacecraft to Earth), component 2 (y), reported in the spacecraft body frame

nadir_vec_wrt_SBF_3.long_name: nadir vector component 3 with respect to spacecraft body frame
nadir_vec_wrt_SBF_3.description: nadir vector (spacecraft to Earth), component 3 (z), reported in the spacecraft body frame

pri_cmd_ref_dir.flag_meanings: [0] ECI_X, [1] ECI_Y, [2] ECI_Z, [3] SUN, [4] MAG (magnetic field vector?), [5] MOON, [6] POS (orbital position vector), [7] VEL (orbital velocity vector), [8] TARG_ECI (target vector, with respect to the ECI frame), [9] TARG_ECEF (target vector, with respect to the ECEF frame), [10] BEARING, [11] HEADING, [12] ORB_NORM (normal vector to the orbit?), [13] GCNADIR (geocentric nadir vector), [14] GDNADIR (geodetic nadir vector)

pri_cmd_vec_wrt_SBF_1.long_name: primary commanded reference vector component 1 with respect to spacecraft body frame
pri_cmd_vec_wrt_SBF_1.description: primary commanded reference vector, component 1 (x), reported in the spacecraft body frame

pri_cmd_vec_wrt_SBF_2.long_name: primary commanded reference vector component 2 with respect to spacecraft body frame
pri_cmd_vec_wrt_SBF_2.description: primary commanded reference vector, component 2 (y), reported in the spacecraft body frame

pri_cmd_vec_wrt_SBF_3.long_name: primary commanded reference vector component 3 with respect to spacecraft body frame
pri_cmd_vec_wrt_SBF_3.description: primary commanded reference vector, component 3 (z), reported in the spacecraft body frame

sec_cmd_ref_dir.flag_meanings: [0] ECI_X, [1] ECI_Y, [2] ECI_Z, [3] SUN, [4] MAG (magnetic field vector?), [5] MOON, [6] POS (orbital position vector), [7] VEL (orbital velocity vector), [8] TARG_ECI (target vector, with respect to the ECI frame), [9] TARG_ECEF (target vector, with respect to the ECEF frame), [10] BEARING, [11] HEADING, [12] ORB_NORM (normal vector to the orbit?), [13] GCNADIR (geocentric nadir vector), [14] GDNADIR (geodetic nadir vector)

sec_cmd_vec_wrt_SBF_1.long_name: secondary commanded reference vector component 1 with respect to spacecraft body frame
sec_cmd_vec_wrt_SBF_1.description: secondary commanded reference vector, component 1 (x), reported in the spacecraft body frame

sec_cmd_vec_wrt_SBF_2.long_name: secondary commanded reference vector component 2 with respect to spacecraft body frame
sec_cmd_vec_wrt_SBF_2.description: secondary commanded reference vector, component 2 (y), reported in the spacecraft body frame

sec_cmd_vec_wrt_SBF_3.long_name: secondary commanded reference vector component 3 with respect to spacecraft body frame
sec_cmd_vec_wrt_SBF_3.description: secondary commanded reference vector, component 3 (z), reported in the spacecraft body frame

cmd_tgt_vec_1.description: commanded target vector, component 1 (x), reported in the ECEF frame if pri_cmd_ref_dir or sec_cmd_ref_dir is TARG_ECEF, otherwise in the ECI frame (?)

cmd_tgt_vec_2.description: commanded target vector, component 2 (y), reported in the ECEF frame if pri_cmd_ref_dir or sec_cmd_ref_dir is TARG_ECEF, otherwise in the ECI frame (?)

cmd_tgt_vec_3.description: commanded target vector, component 3 (z), reported in the ECEF frame if pri_cmd_ref_dir or sec_cmd_ref_dir is TARG_ECEF, otherwise in the ECI frame (?)

cmd_q_scbody_wrt_ECI_1.long_name: commanded quaternion component 1 with respect to ECI frame
cmd_q_scbody_wrt_ECI_1.description: commanded attitude quaternion component 1, spacecraft body frame with respect to ECI (J2000) frame

cmd_q_scbody_wrt_ECI_2.long_name: commanded quaternion component 2 with respect to ECI frame
cmd_q_scbody_wrt_ECI_2.description: commanded attitude quaternion component 2, spacecraft body frame with respect to ECI (J2000) frame

cmd_q_scbody_wrt_ECI_3.long_name: commanded quaternion component 3 with respect to ECI frame
cmd_q_scbody_wrt_ECI_3.description: commanded attitude quaternion component 3, spacecraft body frame with respect to ECI (J2000) frame

cmd_q_scbody_wrt_ECI_4.long_name: commanded quaternion component 4 with respect to ECI frame
cmd_q_scbody_wrt_ECI_4.description: commanded attitude quaternion component 4 (scalar, always positive), spacecraft body frame with respect to ECI (J2000) frame

radio_rx_lock.description: is the spacecraft radio receiver locked onto an expected frequency?

radio_T.description: measured temperature of the spacecraft radio

payload_is_on.description: is the spacecraft payload powered on?

pladj_T_1.description: measured temperature at location 1 adjacent to the spacecraft payload

pladj_T_2.description: measured temperature at location 2 adjacent to the spacecraft payload

bus_T.description: measured temperature somewhere within the spacecraft bus

IMU_T.description: measured temperature at the spacecraft bus IMU (inertial motion unit)

plcmd_T.description: measured bus temperature at the command subsystem supporting the spacecraft payload

plpwr_T.description: measured bus temperature at the power subsystem supporting the spacecraft payload

battery_T.description: measured temperature at the spacecraft battery

battery_V.description: measured voltage from the spacecraft battery

battery_I.description: measured net current to or from (negative values) the spacecraft battery

GPS_is_valid.description: is the GPS (Global Positioning System) solution currently valid?

GPS_sats_tracked.description: number of GPS (Global Positioning System) satellites currently being tracked by the spacecraft

raw_photodiode_space.description: raw data (DN, digital number) from the photodiode near the space aperture of the payload

raw_photodiode_nadir.description: raw data (DN, digital number) from the photodiode near the nadir aperture of the payload

MSA_action_occurring.description: is modeled-sun-avoidance (MSA; on the bus) action currently occurring?

granule_edge_ctime.description: similar to TAI, referenced to the epoch 2000-01-01T00:00:00 UTC, and valid at a granule edge

granule_ID.description: for each granule (defined as starting at each granule edge ctime), an identification number
